label: Applying to the UK for autumn 2027

milestones.label: UCAS applications open
milestones.note: You can register and start writing. Nothing reaches a university yet.

milestones.label: Completed applications can be submitted
milestones.note: A reference from the school is required before anything can be sent, so the school’s internal deadline is earlier than every date on this page.

milestones.label: Oxford, Cambridge, medicine, dentistry and veterinary medicine close
milestones.note: Thirteen months before the course starts. UCAS says it is unusual for these universities to consider a late application. Admissions tests for these courses register earlier still, and the registration deadline is not the test date.

milestones.label: Equal consideration date for most courses
milestones.note: The 13th for 2027 entry, where 2026 entry used the 14th. The date moves between cycles, so a figure remembered from a sibling’s year is worth re-checking.

milestones.label: Extra opens
milestones.note: For anyone who used all five choices and holds no offer: one further choice at a time.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: The point of the conditional offer. Universities confirm or release places against results that have only just arrived, which is what the whole UK calendar is built around.

milestones.label: Clearing opens
milestones.note: For applicants holding no offer, or whose results missed their conditions. Runs on vacancies, so it rewards moving quickly.

milestones.label: Final date for 2027 entry applications
milestones.note: After this the cycle is closed.
